summary_en: Stock swap to make Sharing Innovations wholly owned subsidiary. Exchange ratio: 1 SI share = 0.478 OH shares. 510,791 OH shares to be issued as consideration. No new issuance; Orchestra Holdings will use treasury shares previously acquired. SI final trading 25 Nov 2026; delisting 26 Nov 2026; exchange effective 30 Nov 2026.
title_en: Supplementary materials regarding the full subsidiary acquisition of Sharing Innovations Inc. by stock exchange
translation_en_brief: Orchestra Holdings Inc. has filed supplementary materials regarding the complete acquisition of Sharing Innovations Inc. via stock swap. Under the exchange arrangement, Sharing Innovations will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Orchestra Holdings. The exchange ratio is fixed at 1 Sharing Innovations share = 0.478 Orchestra Holdings shares, resulting in the issuance of 510,791 Orchestra Holdings shares as consideration. Notably, no new shares will be issued; Orchestra Holdings will satisfy the obligation by delivering treasury shares previously acquired. The transaction is scheduled to close on 30 November 2026, with Sharing Innovations' final trading day on 25 November 2026 and delisting on 26 November 2026. The underlying rationale is to leverage group-wide management resources and capabilities for accelerated growth in the DX business.
